spellbook.finance/limitations: qty is a DESIRED TOTAL for that printing in that bin, never an amount to add. Sending qty 4 twice leaves four copies, not eight. To add to an existing count, read the current count first and send the new total.
A desired total BELOW the live count removes nothing. Extra copies are reported as excessQty and stay where they are, because this operation never destroys a copy.

Every entry in `unresolved` is a copy this call refused to write, and `reason` says why: identity_mismatch, archived, terminal_status, in_other_bin, or already_present. Report each one to the person; do not retry it unchanged.

scryfallId, setCode, collectorNumber, condition and finish must be the exact printing the person is holding. Use spellbook_printings_search first. A guessed printing creates a real row that values the wrong card.

An omitted or zero acquisitionPrice records an implied per-card cost, the set's box price divided by its cards per box, with allocation method implied_box_average. Pass the real per-copy cost when the person knows it, and never invent one.
Before a seller's first write, read spellbook_skill getting-started for the bin method. After the write, tell the person the bin id to write on the bag or box the cards go into.
Workspace membership is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

On `free_seller_card_cap_exceeded`, the whole write was refused. Recovery scope is workspace; observedAt timestamps the observation, not later state. cap is the allowance. countIsExact applies to activeUnitCount; false means a lower bound. headroom is admission capacity after reservations, clamped at zero. rowsFit counts requested physical units that fit. Inventory reads and order fulfillment remain available. This says nothing about automation or payment. Offer a smaller request or making room.
The server stamps each copy recorded here with acquisitionSource agent_intake, so the seller can tell it apart from a scan or a CSV import. It publishes on eBay and ManaPool like any other copy.
A ManaBox or TCGplayer export the seller already has goes through spellbook_inventory_import_csv instead.

description: Record physically confirmed cards into one inventory bin, by stating the DESIRED TOTAL quantity of each exact printing that belongs in that bin. Existing live copies count toward that total, so only a missing difference is created. Calling it twice with the same numbers creates nothing the second time. Use it for the first cards a seller enters by hand, with no CSV and no scanner. Returns the created item ids plus every candidate it refused and why.

binId.description: The bin these cards physically sit in. A bin id is a container letter plus an incrementing number, like B0001, where the letter names the physical box and the number names the bag inside it. Required.

items.description: Up to 200 exact printing rows to record in this bin. Required, at least one.

acquisitionPrice.description: Per-copy acquisition cost in USD. When it is omitted or zero, the server records an implied per-card cost from the set's box price instead. Pass the real cost when the person knows it.

acquisitionSource.description: Provenance tag for these rows. Defaults to agent_intake; omit unless a different source genuinely applies.

cardName.description: The card's name, echoed back in the response. Required.

collectorNumber.description: The collector number of this exact printing. Required.

condition.description: The physical condition of these copies. Required.

finish.description: The finish of these copies, using the values listed in this field. Pokemon supports nf (Normal/Unlimited), fo (Holofoil), rh (Reverse Holofoil), 1e (1st Edition) and 1e-fo (1st Edition Holofoil); other games have their own valid finishes. Required.

qty.description: The DESIRED TOTAL count of this exact printing, condition and finish in this bin, never an amount to add. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact printing id, from spellbook_printings_search. Required; a wrong id records the wrong card.

setCode.description: The set code of this exact printing. Required.

physicallyConfirmed.description: Must be true, asserting a person has physically counted these cards. The call is refused when this is omitted or false.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to record these cards into. Required; writes only to this workspace.
